name: Bathroom Therapy
source:
A short one-off Visual novel about a guy and his "Trap" roommate getting steamy in the bathtub.

[From [url=https://waywardvoidgod.itch.io/bathroom-therapy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
這是一部獨立成篇的短篇視覺小說。一個年輕人和他那位男扮女裝的室友一起洗澡，兩人在浴缸裡親熱起來。

（來源：[url=https://waywardvoidgod.itch.io/bathroom-therapy]itch.io[/url]）
